errorCodes.meaning: The requested path is already in use on the hosting server.
The named DID template does not exist in the selected scope.

The did:scid form was requested, but the alias cannot be listed in alsoKnownAs: the request sets scidAlsoKnownAs to false, or the template, the supplied didDocument or the supplied didLog does not allow it.

DidMethod.description: The identity a did:webvh log is presented as. `webvh` is `did:webvh:<scid>:<host>[:<path>]`. `scid` is `did:scid:vh:1:<scid>`, verified by the same log and located by `?src=<host>[/<path>]`; it requires the alias in `alsoKnownAs`. In a request, absent means the VTA applies its configuration (`webvh` unless configured otherwise); in a response, the form the VTA applied, and `did` is in that form.
DidMethod.title: DidMethod

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

did.description: The new identity, in the form `didMethod` names: the did:webvh DID, or the bare `did:scid:vh:1:<scid>` DID.

didDocument.description: The published document, when the VTA composed one.

logEntry.description: The log's first entry. For a serverless DID this is what the caller must serve — the DID does not resolve until they do.

mnemonic.description: The hosting server's handle for the record. Absent for a serverless DID.

preRotationKeyCount.description: Successor keys committed. `0` means pre-rotation is off for this DID.

scid.description: Self-certifying identifier committing to the log's first entry.

scidAlsoKnownAs.description: Whether the first log entry lists `scidDidUrl` in `alsoKnownAs`.

scidDidUrl.description: The `did:scid:vh:1:<scid>?src=<source>` DID URL of the log: the did:scid DID with the locator a recipient needs to resolve it. A producer gives this out, rather than the bare DID, wherever the recipient may not hold a source.

serverId.description: The hosting server the DID was published through. Absent exactly when `serverless` is true.

serverless.description: True when no hosting server was published to: the VTA holds the log, and the DID does not resolve until the caller serves `logEntry` at the DID's URL. Stated, rather than left to be inferred from an absent `serverId`, so a client can refuse to rely on a DID nobody serves.

webvhDid.description: The did:webvh DID of the log. Equal to `did` when `didMethod` is `webvh`.

schema.description: Mint a did:webvh: the VTA generates the keys, writes the log's first entry, and either hands it to a hosting server or returns it for the caller to serve.

addMediatorService.description: Add a DIDComm mediator service entry to the document.

addTspService.description: Add a TSP transport service entry to the document.

contextId.description: Context the DID belongs to. Its keys are minted here, and deleting the context destroys the DID.

didDocument.description: A DID document to publish rather than one the VTA composes.

didLog.description: An existing log to adopt, for importing a DID minted elsewhere.

domain.description: Hosting domain to publish under, when the server serves more than one.

kaKeyId.description: Existing key-agreement key to publish. Absent mints a new one.

path.description: Explicit path label under the host. Shorthand for pathMode `explicit`; supplying both is an error.

pathMode.description: How the path under the host is chosen. Absent means `autoAssign`.

portable.description: Whether this DID may later move to another domain and keep its identity. **Fixed at creation** — portability is committed in the first log entry and cannot be added afterwards. A DID created non-portable is tied to where it was published for its whole life.

preRotationCount.description: How many successor keys to commit in advance. **`0` disables pre-rotation**, which means a compromise of the current key cannot be recovered from by rotating: the successor was never committed, so a thief can rotate to their own key as convincingly as the owner can.

scidAlsoKnownAs.description: Whether the first log entry lists the `did:scid:vh:1` DID URL of the new log (with `src`) in `alsoKnownAs`, linking the two forms as one subject. Absent means the VTA applies its configuration, which defaults to `true`. `false` with `didMethod` `scid` is refused.

serverId.description: Hosting server to publish through. Absent means **serverless**: the caller serves the log itself at `url`, and the VTA holds no hosting registration for it.

setPrimary.description: Make this the context's primary DID.

signingKeyId.description: Existing key to sign log entries with. Absent mints a new one.

template.description: DID template to render the document from (see vta/did-templates/*).

templateContext.description: Context whose templates to resolve `template` against. Absent uses the global scope, which is a different namespace and may hold a different template of the same name.

url.description: Where the log will be served, for the serverless case. The DID's identity derives from this location, so changing it later is only possible for a `portable` DID.
